primary_source_checks.finding: Phase II randomized; 217 patients (145 vs 72); median follow-up 20.2 months; ORR 69% vs 46%, P=.001; 18-month DOR 69% vs 42%.
primary_source_checks.status: primary abstract checked; full safety/supplement and protocol schedule incomplete

primary_source_checks.finding: Phase III randomized; 823 patients; first-line RAS-wild-type metastatic CRC; left-sided response 80.2% vs 68.6%; full OS/safety/PRO extraction not completed.
primary_source_checks.status: abstract checked only; publisher terms restrict full-text AI text/data mining

primary_source_checks.finding: Final analysis: 452 enrolled; OS 16.8 vs 13.3 months; HR 0.77 (95% CI 0.62–0.95), P=.007.
primary_source_checks.status: primary/final abstract checked; complete arm-level safety and treatment details incomplete

primary_source_checks.finding: Primary NEJM source indexed; 14.8% discontinued tisotumab vedotin because of toxic effects.
primary_source_checks.status: primary source partially checked; full grade 3–5/ocular toxicity and QoL tables incomplete

primary_source_checks.finding: 12-month PFS dMMR 74% vs 38%, HR 0.30 (95% CI 0.19–0.48), P<.001; pMMR median PFS 13.1 vs 8.7 months, HR 0.54 (95% CI 0.41–0.71), P<.001; grade 3–4 AEs 63.3% vs 47.2% (dMMR) and 55.1% vs 45.3% (pMMR).
primary_source_checks.status: primary source excerpt checked; full tables, PRO and structured absolute-effect markup incomplete

primary_source_checks.finding: 18-month EFS 70.2% vs 50.0%; HR 0.58 (97.36% CI 0.42–0.81), P<.001; grade 3–4 treatment-related AEs 32.5% vs 25.2%.
primary_source_checks.status: primary abstract checked; full regimen/safety/PRO tables and structured effect markup incomplete

primary_source_checks.finding: Recurrent VTE 5.6% vs 7.9% (superiority P=.08; noninferiority P<.001); major bleeding 3.8% vs 4.0%, P=.60.
primary_source_checks.status: primary source excerpt checked; full subgroup/safety and QoL status incomplete; no fixed-horizon NNT assigned

primary_source_checks.finding: 1,766 randomized; 12-month recurrent VTE 2.1% vs 2.8%, adjusted subhazard ratio 0.76 (95% CI 0.41–1.41), P=.001 for noninferiority; clinically relevant bleeding 12.1% vs 15.6%, adjusted subhazard ratio 0.75 (95% CI 0.58–0.97), P=.03.
primary_source_checks.status: primary abstract/tables excerpt checked; full bleeding severity, discontinuation and PRO tables incomplete
primary source excerpt checked; treatment exposure differs; fixed-horizon NNH 35 is not defensible and should be removed

primary_source_checks.finding: Median follow-up 9.9 months; 12-month EFS 83.7% vs 57.2%; HR 0.32 (99.9% CI 0.15–0.66), P<.001; grade ≥3 systemic-treatment AEs 29.7% vs 14.7%.
primary_source_checks.status: primary source excerpt checked; response-adapted regimen, full surgery/safety/PRO tables incomplete

primary_source_checks.finding: PRO analysis: ≥15% abdominal/GI symptom improvement at week 8/9, 21.9% vs 9.3%; difference 12.7% (95% CI 4.4–20.9), P=.002; MMRM difference 6.4 points, P=.015.
primary_source_checks.status: primary PRO publication checked; full primary safety and domain-level PRO extraction incomplete
